<!--
Template of the seasonal adjustment report used by rjd3report::render_report().
It can be copied with rjd3report::use_report_template() and customized:
the models and the options of rjd3report::sa_report() are stored in the file `params$models`.
-->

```{r}
#| label: sa-report
library(rjd3report)
data <- readRDS(params$models)
do.call(sa_report, c(list(data$models), data$options))
```
